snippet.title: Robo Frenzy - Tokyo Game Show trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist and play the Tokyo Game Show demo!

Robo Frenzy is a sandbox boss battling game where you craft weapons and construct machines while fighting giant robots. Beatdown colossal computers solo or with a friend in co-op mode and bring parts back to build your own cyber city. Hack, slash, craft, construct, and automate.

We’re excited to bring Robo Frenzy to Tokyo Game Show as a selected indie game and we want to give everyone at home a chance to clash with kaiju-sized robots. For a limited time, we're rolling out a special TGS demo, but it's only available until October 2!

Brace yourself as two colossal bosses are ready to put your battling and building skills to the test in this demo. Duel with a cranky computer cunning enough to swipe the weapons you’ve crafted in Omniland’s town square. Then, face off against a furious typewriter that’s not thrilled about all these modern touchscreen devices. You can play the Robo Frenzy demo in single player or with a friend in local co-op mode.
